The '''Power Guard Recruitment Center''' was used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Republic Strategic Information Service|Strategic Information Service]] where it recruited volunteers for the [[Power Guard Enhancement System|Power Guard Project]]. It was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="TOR" />
